examples.arabic: الرحلة دي من احلام العيلة من زمان ونفسنا ننبسط
examples.english: This trip is one of the family's dreams for a long time and we hope to have fun.
examples.transliteration: El rehla di men ahlam el eila men zaman wa nefsina nenbest

examples.arabic: الرحلة دي زي احلام جميلة لينا
examples.english: This trip is like beautiful dreams for us.
examples.transliteration: el rehla de zay ahlam gamila lina

examples.english: They are ready for the beautiful trip now.
examples.transliteration: Homa gahzeen lel rehla el helwa delwaqty

examples.english: Today we are thinking about a trip.
Welcome to you with me on the trip
examples.transliteration: Ahlan beek maaya fi el rehla

examples.english: The children are very happy with the trip.
